[2408.17007] A Liouville theorem for the Lane-Emden system in the half-space

arXiv:2408.17007 (math)
[Submitted on 30 Aug 2024 (v1), last revised 5 Jun 2025 (this version, v2)]
Title:A Liouville theorem for the Lane-Emden system in the half-space
Authors:Yimei Li, Philippe Souplet
View a PDF of the paper titled A Liouville theorem for the Lane-Emden system in the half-space, by Yimei Li and 1 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:We prove that the Dirichlet problem for the Lane-Emden system in a half-space has no positive classical solution that is bounded on finite strips. Such a nonexistence result was previously available only for bounded solutions or under a restriction on the powers in the nonlinearities.
Comments:
14 pages, minor typos corrected in v2
